events.title: The Village Tree Lighting
events.blurb: Hot chocolate and Christmas music on the historic front lawn, then Santa lights the tree at 6:15 p.m. Some Mercato shops stay open late for Small Business Saturday.
events.blurbEs: Chocolate caliente y música navideña en el histórico jardín delantero; luego Santa enciende el árbol a las 6:15 p.m. Algunas tiendas del Mercato abren hasta tarde por Small Business Saturday.

events.title: Indoor Farmers Market
events.blurb: More than 30 vendors sell eggs, meats, cheeses, produce and fresh bread in the Mercato corridor.
events.blurbEs: Más de 30 vendedores ofrecen huevos, carnes, quesos, frutas y verduras, y pan recién hecho en el pasillo del Mercato.

events.title: Black Friday & Small Business Saturday
events.addr: E Front St, Traverse City, MI 49684
events.blurb: Downtown shops and restaurants, mostly along Front Street, offer holiday deals and in-store events. Each business sets its own hours.
events.blurbEs: Las tiendas y restaurantes del centro, sobre todo en Front Street, ofrecen ofertas navideñas y actividades en sus locales. Cada negocio fija su propio horario.

events.title: Santa's House
events.addr: Cass St & State St, Traverse City, MI 49684
events.blurb: Visit Santa downtown at City Centre Plaza through December 24.
events.blurbEs: Visita a Santa en el centro, en City Centre Plaza, hasta el 24 de diciembre.

events.title: The Alluvion Big Band
events.addr: 414 E Eighth St, Traverse City, MI 49686
events.blurb: Traverse City's big band of professional Michigan musicians, directed by Chris Glassman, plays its last-Sunday-of-the-month afternoon show.
events.blurbEs: La big band de Traverse City, con músicos profesionales de Michigan y dirigida por Chris Glassman, ofrece su concierto de la tarde del último domingo de cada mes.

events.title: Northport's Annual Holiday Concert
events.blurb: The Village Voices and the Northport Community Band play holiday classics and new music, ending with a singalong. Northport is about 28 miles north of Traverse City.
events.blurbEs: The Village Voices y la Northport Community Band interpretan clásicos navideños y música nueva, y cierran cantando todos juntos. Northport está a unas 28 millas al norte de Traverse City.

events.title: Dennos Museum Center
events.addr: 1701 E Front St, Traverse City, MI 49686
events.blurb: The art museum at Northwestern Michigan College is closed Thanksgiving and Friday, then reopens Saturday and Sunday.
events.blurbEs: El museo de arte de Northwestern Michigan College cierra el Día de Acción de Gracias y el viernes, y vuelve a abrir el sábado y el domingo.

events.title: Great Lakes Children's Museum
events.addr: 3200 W South Airport Rd, Ste 420, Traverse City, MI 49684
events.blurb: Hands-on museum for young kids inside the Grand Traverse Mall.
events.blurbEs: Museo interactivo para niños pequeños dentro del Grand Traverse Mall.

events.title: Clinch Park & the bay
events.addr: 181 E Grandview Pkwy, Traverse City, MI 49684
events.blurb: Downtown's beach park on West Grand Traverse Bay.
events.blurbEs: El parque con playa del centro en West Grand Traverse Bay.
